definition.description: Measure latest reported gross margin (GrossProfit/revenue) minus the same fiscal window one year earlier. Anchor to latest canonical revenue end and shortest explicitly reported duration on a tied end, before requiring current profit or comparators. Require exact month-aligned 3/6/9/12-month windows and same currency; YTD compares identical YTD windows. Missing current/prior gross profit or revenue, zero revenue, unresolved required-window conflicts, stale current periods, unsupported stubs or 52/53-week calendars are unavailable; never replace the latest anchor with an older complete pair. Numeric change >=0.08 is positive, <=-0.02 negative, otherwise neutral; categories describe this measurement, not future returns. Preserve full literal operands and evidence. Default current freshness is 550 days; absolute change above 2 has partial coverage and confidence 0.5 without changing the measurement.

execution.contract:
With period_policy=same_window_yoy, measure latest GrossProfit/revenue minus
    the same reported fiscal window's margin one year earlier. Require exact
    month-aligned 3/6/9/12-month windows, matching currency and latest revenue anchor;
    no older complete fallback or unresolved conflicts. Missing current profit or
    any comparator is unavailable. Unknown explicit policies are unavailable.
    Without period_policy preserve legacy behavior: latest margin minus the previous
    comparable-duration margin. GrossProfit and revenue must match start, end and units
    within each period, and revenue comes from the per-issuer canonical total series
    (dominance-resolved; partial or zero same-period tag values never displace the
    total). Missing matched periods, zero revenue or stale current facts yield
    unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default
    positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is
    negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. Values beyond
    plausible_abs_max (default 2) are downgraded to partial coverage at 0.5 confidence
    with an implausible_value marker. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current
    SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.

definition.description: Measure revenue acceleration as the latest standalone quarter's YoY revenue growth minus the immediately preceding standalone quarter's YoY growth, requiring all four explicitly reported windows. For latest annual inputs, compare adjacent annual YoY growth and require three annual windows. Anchor to latest canonical revenue end, shortest explicitly reported duration on a tied end. Require exact month-aligned 3-month quarterly or 12-month annual boundaries and same currency. Never skip a quarter, mix quarterly with annual growth, synthesize standalone quarters from YTD or fall back to an older complete pair. Missing current/year-ago/adjacent/year-ago-adjacent windows, zero prior-year denominators, unresolved required-window conflicts, stale current periods, cumulative YTD, unsupported stubs or 52/53-week calendars are unavailable. Numeric acceleration >=0.05 is positive, <=-0.05 negative, otherwise neutral; categories describe this measurement, not future returns. Preserve full literal operands and evidence. Default current freshness is 550 days; absolute acceleration above 5 has partial coverage and confidence 0.5 without changing the measurement.

execution.contract:
With period_policy=adjacent_yoy, measure current standalone quarter YoY growth
    minus immediately previous quarter YoY growth (four reported windows); annual
    uses adjacent annual YoY growth (three windows). Require exact month-aligned
    boundaries, currency and latest anchor; no skipped quarter, YTD derivation,
    mixed cadence, older complete fallback or unresolved conflicts. Missing inputs
    are unavailable. An unknown explicit policy is unavailable. Without period_policy,
    preserve legacy behavior: latest year-over-year revenue growth minus an earlier
    comparable growth rate. Requires two supported revenue year-over-year pairs from the
    per-issuer canonical total series (dominance-resolved; never mixed-basis), with
    matching units and nonzero denominators; incomplete/stale current facts yield
    unavailable. Numeric states use positive_min (default 0) and negative_max (default
    positive_min): value >= positive_min is positive, otherwise value <= negative_max is
    negative, otherwise neutral. Thresholds do not change the measurement. Values beyond
    plausible_abs_max (default 5) are downgraded to partial coverage at 0.5 confidence
    with an implausible_value marker. max_period_age_days (default 550) bounds current
    SEC period age; older comparative periods remain allowed.
